pond.title: Hamlet Pond
pond.what: A small pond southwest of the cottage and west of the waterside hall. Approach its shore for a swim; the cottage stands on the nearby grassy knoll.

plaza.title: Plaza Marker
plaza.what: A flag marking the hamlet’s central meeting point. It labels a proposed plaza rather than a furnished square.

orchard.title: Orchard Marker
orchard.what: A flag marking the proposed orchard, away from the cottage. It is a navigation landmark; the marker alone does not establish fruit trees or a harvest.

knoll.title: Cottage Knoll
knoll.what: The grassy rise supporting the cottage. Walk uphill toward the house for the hamlet’s indoor rooms and its outdoor bench.

cottage.title: Knoll Cottage
cottage.what: A small one-story home on the grassy rise, with a living room, kitchen and bedroom. The two-seat bench outside provides a place to sit after visiting the rooms.

parts.title: Outdoor Bench
parts.what: A bench seat outside the cottage.

cottage/bench.title: Cottage Bench
cottage/bench.what: A two-seat wooden bench outside Knoll Cottage, suited to a quiet pause on the hill.

lab-start.title: Village Green
lab-start.what: An open meeting patch at the plaza flag, between the presentation hall to the east and the closed reading room to the northwest.

lab-presentation-hall.title: Presentation Hall
lab-presentation-hall.what: A small hall northeast of the green for giving talks. A presenter’s chair stands beside a desk at the back, facing an audience bench. Enter through the south door.

parts.title: Presenter’s Chair
parts.what: The chair beside the presenter’s desk, facing the audience bench.

parts.title: Audience Bench
parts.what: A bench facing the presenter at the back of the hall.

lab-presentation-hall/presenter-seat.title: Presenter’s Chair
lab-presentation-hall/presenter-seat.what: The presentation seat beside the desk at the back of the hall.

lab-presentation-hall/presenter-desk.title: Presenter’s Desk
lab-presentation-hall/presenter-desk.what: A desk beside the presenter’s chair, facing the audience area.

lab-presentation-hall/audience-bench.title: Audience Bench
lab-presentation-hall/audience-bench.what: A two-seat bench for listeners facing the presenter.

lab-pond-hall.title: Waterside Hall
lab-pond-hall.what: A small gathering hall beside the eastern shore of Hamlet Pond, south of the village green. Its north-facing doorway leads into one room.

parts.title: Waterside Room
parts.what: The single indoor room beside the pond.

lab-reading-room.title: Closed Reading Room
lab-reading-room.what: A small reading room northwest of the green. Its only door is closed, so entry is unavailable. The outdoor cottage bench is another place to pause.

worldAbout.title: Hello Hamlet
worldAbout.what: A small hamlet with a cottage on a grassy knoll, a pond, a presentation hall, a waterside hall and a closed reading room.
worldAbout.tour: Start at the Village Green near the plaza flag. The Presentation Hall to the northeast has a presenter’s chair beside a desk and an audience bench. South of the green, Waterside Hall stands beside Hamlet Pond. The closed Reading Room is northwest; Knoll Cottage and its outdoor bench are east of the green. The Orchard flag marks a proposed orchard, not planted fruit trees.
